name: @trivial-so/cli
description: The trivial folder-path client — pull/push your Trivial project from your laptop.

scripts.build:serve: pnpm run build && mkdir -p ../ui/public/cli && cp dist/trivial.cjs ../ui/public/cli/trivial.js && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('../ui/public/cli/version.json', JSON.stringify({version:process.env.npm_package_version})+'\n')"
